The Board is of the opinion that the risk of fire to plant & machinery and current assets, fluctuations in raw material prices, dependence on major customers and changes in Government Policies are the elements of risk that pose major challenges to the Company.

Volatility of raw material prices and demand by bulk consumers of fatty acids for contracts of large quantities for future delivery is a big challenge to the Company when similar facility for advance coverage of raw materials is not available to hedge the risks.
